target: source building of a completed daily electrical profile
test_rule: last 20% of eligible distinct dates; all buildings share each date's partition
cv: 3 expanding chronological folds, each with seven calendar days purged before validation
selection: highest mean validation macro F1; ties follow fixed candidate order
predictors: power and signed power factor summaries only
test_policy: select and serialize the development-fitted model before one final test evaluation; no refit on test
